🌍 Three violating vessels catch fire after striking naval mines in Strait of Hormuz: Iran’s Army Navy 📌 Tehran, IRNA – The Iranian Army Navy has announced that three oil tankers caught fire in the eastern part of the Strait of Hormuz after violating maritime regulations. In a statement on Wednesday, the Iranian Army Navy Public Relations Office announced that three oil tankers had caught fire after striking naval mines in the eastern part of the Strait of Hormuz. ​ The statement added that the vessels had ignored warnings issued by the Army Navy, switched off their navigation systems and entered a prohibited area east of the Strait of Hormuz before striking naval mines and catching fire. ​ It stressed that all vessels transiting the Strait of Hormuz must comply with regulations announced by Iran’s Armed Forces, coordinate with the relevant authorities, use authorized maritime corridors, and keep their tracking and navigation systems active. ​ It further warned that vessels failing to meet these requirements would face the risk of striking naval mines and catching fire. 📲 @Irna_en ​
